service_requests.title: Complete DB Box Overhaul & Master Circuit Breaker Tripping Resolution
service_requests.description: Main switchboard sparking on heavy appliance load. Requires full load rebalancing, replacement of burnt 32A MCB, and insulation testing across 4 circuit lines.
service_requests.address: Flat 402, Neelkanth Valley, Ghatkopar East, Mumbai - 400077
service_requests.materials_used: 1x Havells 16A MCB, 15m Polycab FR 2.5 wire, PVC insulation tape
service_requests.completion_notes: Replaced burnt MCB with genuine Havells 16A unit. Neutral loop corrected. Tested on 4kW heating load with Fluke meter. Megger insulation resistance > 100 Megaohms.
service_requests.review_comment: Exceptional cooperative service! John arrived promptly with safety gear and resolved the dangerous sparking in less than 3 hours. Transparent rates!

service_requests.review_comment: Extremely reliable cooperative execution. Society committee appreciated the detailed bill of materials and digital warranty.
